daily_scope: Unchanged run_month daily seconds: money, bank, work, browser entries, complete daily oracle, roles, scheduler and provenance. Excludes the separately timed day-15 ops checkpoint. No daily checks may be skipped to meet the budget.
network_scope: Local HTTP round trip, including server work and response receipt; successful endpoint calls only. Failures are still qualification failures independently of latency.
baseline: First completed day in the same fresh run, on the same frozen build. Limits fixed before the run; no retrospective relaxation. The daily ceiling is explicitly 1.703 times day one, including bank-import days.
